evidence.snippet: Once you register, feel free to create a trial account and reach out to [email protected] to transform it into a developer account.
As an admin, you can easily generate and revoke your access token in the settings of your account.

decisions.reason: Working credentials require first creating a trial Gorgias account (and admin access within it), with continued/developer use needing an email request or eventual paid plan, so this is self-serve but trial-gated rather than fully free.

evidence.snippet: the API key authentication method can be used only for private apps . If you plan to build a public app you have to use OAuth2.
Using OAuth2 is mandatory for public apps.

decisions.reason: Docs explicitly define two supported auth methods: API key (HTTP Basic) for private apps and OAuth2 for public apps.

evidence.snippet: the connection URL is the same: https://mcp.gorgias.com/mcp
The Gorgias MCP lets you work with your Gorgias helpdesk using an AI assistant, like Claude or ChatGPT.

decisions.reason: Gorgias's own help docs (docs.gorgias.com) publish and describe this MCP endpoint as 'the Gorgias MCP', confirming it is vendor-official.
